suiteTitle: Queue Second-Order Failure Mode Recall (v4 Discoveries)
description: Hardened rubric evaluating recall of seven second-order queue failure modes using multi-facet semantic matching.

hiddenKeys.description: Fenced domain result promotion and transactional outbox emission guarded against superseded workers.
hiddenKeys.business_contract_expected: Authoritative business writes, ledger entries, or outbox records must be fenced by the current execution generation token.
hiddenKeys.failure_scenario_expected: Paused worker wakes after lease expiry and attempts domain writes during concurrent execution by replacement worker.
hiddenKeys.validation_test_expected: Inject worker delay, wait for lease expiry, let replacement worker succeed, verify original worker's write is rejected with 0 rows mutated.

hiddenKeys.description: River state-only finalization edge condition (state='running' without worker generation token check).
hiddenKeys.business_contract_expected: Storage engine must enforce ownership tokens or document state-only finalization limitations to prevent un-interrupted stale completes.
hiddenKeys.failure_scenario_expected: Slow worker executes without cancellation check and completes job row despite lease expiration.
hiddenKeys.validation_test_expected: Execute job without renewer, verify whether completion SQL succeeds on state='running' alone.

hiddenKeys.description: Authoritative storage-time recovery vs caller-supplied VM-local 'now' timestamp footgun.
hiddenKeys.business_contract_expected: Lease evaluation and recovery sweeps must rely solely on storage engine server time, forbidding application-supplied timestamps in production queries.
hiddenKeys.failure_scenario_expected: Worker VM clock drifts forward/backward by 30 seconds, causing premature rescue or stalled job starvation.
hiddenKeys.validation_test_expected: Step client VM clock by +/- 60 seconds while keeping database clock steady; assert recovery schedule remains unchanged.

hiddenKeys.description: Separate tracking of attempts-started, attempts-completed, and worker-loss/stalled counters.
hiddenKeys.business_contract_expected: System must maintain separate counters for total dequeue attempts, application-level handler failures, and unacknowledged worker crashes.
hiddenKeys.failure_scenario_expected: Repeated worker SIGKILLs cause poison jobs to be re-attempted indefinitely if only explicit error handler catches increment counters.
hiddenKeys.validation_test_expected: SIGKILL worker during active execution; verify attempt counter is incremented at claim time or marked during recovery sweep.

hiddenKeys.description: Poison payload isolation from repeatable/scheduler job stall exemptions.
hiddenKeys.business_contract_expected: Hard payload crashes and poison pill errors must bypass scheduler stall exemptions and route directly to dead-letter quarantine.
hiddenKeys.failure_scenario_expected: Corrupt cron task payload crashes worker parser on every iteration, creating an infinite crash loop if maxStalledCount is ignored for repeatable tasks.
hiddenKeys.validation_test_expected: Submit unparseable payload to a repeatable cron queue; verify task fails to DLQ after N attempts rather than looping infinitely.

hiddenKeys.description: Bounded admission waiters and explicit storage stall rejection (waiter queues as independent resource limits).
hiddenKeys.business_contract_expected: Concurrency semaphores must enforce hard capacity bounds on queued waiters, immediately rejecting surplus requests when storage stalls.
hiddenKeys.failure_scenario_expected: Storage engine I/O stalls; thousands of incoming requests pile up in memory waiting for semaphores, causing process OOM crash.
hiddenKeys.validation_test_expected: Simulate 5-second disk flush freeze with 10k concurrent producer requests; verify broker rejects overflow with transient error without memory growth.

hiddenKeys.description: Decoupled worker-drain and broker-socket shutdown contracts (renewer termination vs TCP drain deadlines).
hiddenKeys.business_contract_expected: Shutdown sequences must decouple in-flight worker job completion deadlines from broker TCP socket termination timeouts.
hiddenKeys.failure_scenario_expected: Worker halt stops task fetcher but leaves background lease renewers running indefinitely on stuck tasks, or broker blocks on slow TCP client drain.
hiddenKeys.validation_test_expected: Send SIGTERM while a 30-second job is running and slow client is connected; verify socket closes within 2s and worker drains within 30s.
